questions.question:
[지문]
Luigi packed his ship with wonderful paintings and other works of art. He took the gifts to the island. To get a chance to meet the queen, he told the islanders a lie that he was a good friend of Antonio's. When the queen heard about Luigi, she invited him to her palace for dinner. Before sitting down at the table, Luigi presented the queen with all his gifts, and the queen thanked him again and again. "I'll repay you with a priceless gift," said the queen.

Luigi watched the queen whisper in a servant's ear. He became excited and hopeful.

After a while, the servant returned with a box, and the queen presented it to Luigi. When Luigi opened the box, he was speechless.

There was a kitten in the box. "Antonio gave us the priceless cats, and we now have some kittens," said the queen. "In return for the wonderful gifts you gave us, we want to give you ⓐwhat is most valuable to us."

위 글의 ⓐ와 동일한 용법으로 쓰인 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ의 'what'은 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사로 '~하는 것'의 의미입니다. 'what is most valuable to us'에서 what은 관계대명사로 명사절을 이끌며 'the thing which'로 바꿀 수 있습니다. ⑤ 'This book is what I like the most.'에서 what도 동일하게 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사로 쓰였습니다. ①②③은 의문대명사/의문형용사로 쓰인 what이고, ④는 감탄문입니다.

위 글에서 답을 찾을 수 있는 질문을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?

<보기>
ⓐ What did Luigi do before dinner?
ⓑ Why couldn't Luigi say anything?
ⓒ What made Luigi jealous of Antonio?
ⓓ How did Luigi change at the end of the story?

questions.explanation: ⓐ 저녁 식사 전에 Luigi가 한 일 → 여왕에게 선물을 바쳤다고 본문에 나옴 (답 찾을 수 있음). ⓑ Luigi가 말을 못한 이유 → 상자 안에 고양이 새끼가 있었기 때문 (답 찾을 수 있음). ⓒ Luigi가 Antonio를 질투하게 된 이유 → 본문에 나오지 않음. ⓓ 이야기 끝에 Luigi가 어떻게 변했는지 → 본문에 나오지 않음. ⓔ Luigi가 여왕을 만날 기회를 얻은 방법 → Antonio의 친구라고 거짓말을 했다고 나옴 (답 찾을 수 있음). 따라서 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓔ가 정답입니다.

Isabel lives in a small village near Kakamega, Kenya. In the past, she had to walk a long distance every day to get clean water. She sometimes got sick because of the dirty water she drank. Three months ago, she received a valuable gift from a volunteer worker. It looks like a thick straw. Dirty water goes into the straw, and clean water comes out of it. Isabel carries the straw everywhere. Now, she does not get sick anymore. She can go to school every day. So, the straw is what is most valuable to Isabel.

윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 Isabel은 과거에 깨끗한 물을 구하기 위해 매일 먼 거리를 걸어야 했다고 했습니다(she had to walk a long distance every day to get clean water). 따라서 '깨끗한 물을 구할 필요가 없었다'는 ③번은 내용과 일치하지 않습니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Long ago, an honest merchant lived in Genoa, Italy. His name was Antonio, and he went to different places to support his family by trading. One day, he filled his ship with goods and visited a faraway island. There he traded tools for spices and books for nuts. Thanks to Antonio, the islanders could get what they needed.

One night, Antonio had dinner with the island's queen at her palace. When dinner was served, rats appeared, and some servants chased them away with sticks.

Antonio was greatly surprised that ⓐ__________. He asked, "Are there no cats on this island?" The queen looked puzzled. "What is a cat?" she asked.

The merchant said to himself, "What the islanders here need is not tools or books, but cats." He brought two cats from his ship and let them run free. "What amazing animals!" cried the queen when she saw all the rats run away. She gave Antonio a chest that was filled with jewels.

다음 중 윗글에서 Antonio에 관한 설명으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 본문 마지막 문장 'She gave Antonio a chest that was filled with jewels.'에서 여왕이 Antonio에게 보석이 가득 찬 상자를 주었음을 알 수 있습니다. ①근거없음, ②도구를 향신료와 교환했고 책을 견과류와 교환했으므로 오답, ③자신의 집이 아닌 여왕의 궁전에서 저녁을 먹었으므로 오답, ④고양이가 쓸모없다고 한 것이 아니라 반대로 필요하다고 판단했으므로 오답.

(B) 'the straw (B) the volunteer worker gave her'에서 앞에 선행사 'the straw'가 있으므로 관계대명사 that이 적절합니다. (C) 'the straw is (C) is most valuable to Isabel'에서 선행사가 없으므로 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사 what이 적절합니다. 따라서 (A) that, (B) that, (C) what인 ④가 정답입니다.

윗글의 Isabel에 관한 내용과 일치하는 것은?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 Isabel이 받은 선물은 두꺼운 빨대처럼 생긴 것으로, 더러운 물이 들어가면 깨끗한 물이 나옵니다. 이 덕분에 Isabel은 더 이상 아프지 않고 매일 학교에 갈 수 있게 되었습니다. 따라서 ④가 일치하는 내용입니다. ⑤는 학교에 갈 필요가 없어진 것이 아니라 매일 학교에 갈 수 있게 된 것이므로 오답입니다.

questions.question:

Luigi packed his ship with wonderful paintings and other works of art. He took the gifts to the island. To get a chance ⓐmeet the queen, he told the islanders a lie that he was a good friend of Antonio's. When the queen heard about Luigi, she invited him to her palace for dinner. Before ⓑsit down at the table, The queen ⓒwas presented all his gifts, and she thanked him again and again. "I'll ⓓrepaying you with a priceless gift," said the queen. Luigi watched the queen ⓔto whisper in a servant's ear. He became excited and hopeful. He was sure that he would receive more jewels than Antonio.

밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 옳은 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: ⓐ meet → to meet (to부정사가 와야 함: a chance to meet). ⓑ sit → sitting (Before는 전치사이므로 동명사 sitting이 와야 함). ⓒ was presented: Luigi가 선물을 여왕에게 바친 것인데 원문에서는 'Luigi presented the queen with all his gifts'가 맞지만 여기서는 'The queen was presented all his gifts'로 수동태 표현으로 쓰였으므로 어법상 가능합니다. ⓓ repaying → repay (I'll 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 함). ⓔ to whisper → whisper (watch는 지각동사로 목적격보어에 원형부정사가 와야 함).

options: useless
valueless
priceless

"Antonio gave us the ___(A)___ cats, and we now have some kittens," said the queen. "In return for the wonderful gifts you gave us, we want to give you a kitten." Luigi realized that, in the queen's mind, the kitten was worth far more than all the jewels in the world.

Based on the context, which of the following is most suitable for (A)?
questions.explanation: 문맥상 여왕이 Antonio에게 받은 고양이들이 매우 귀중했다는 의미가 되어야 합니다. 또한 원본 지문에서도 'priceless cats'라는 표현이 사용되었습니다. 'priceless'는 '값을 매길 수 없을 만큼 귀중한'이라는 뜻으로 문맥에 가장 적절합니다. 'useless', 'valueless', 'worthless'는 부정적인 의미이며, 'speechless'는 '말문이 막힌'이라는 의미로 맥락에 맞지 않습니다.

options: I saw the child walking his dog in the park.

questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation: 지각동사(see, hear, watch, feel 등)의 목적격 보어로는 동사원형 또는 현재분사가 옵니다. ①은 'walking'(현재분사)으로 올바릅니다. ②는 'to break' → 'break'로, ③은 'ran' → 'run'으로, ④는 'said' → 'say'로, ⑤는 'shook' → 'shake'로 고쳐야 합니다.

options: I enjoy eating what my dad cooked.
Grades are what it worries me most.
What I need are a glass of cool water.
Teamwork is what important for a successful project.
The family went to a store to buy things what did they need.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 정확하게 표현된 문장은?
questions.explanation: ①은 관계대명사 'what'이 'eating'의 목적어 역할을 하는 명사절로 올바릅니다. ②는 'what it worries' → 'what worries'로, ③은 'are' → 'is'로(what절이 주어일 때 단수 취급), ④는 'what important' → 'what is important'로, ⑤는 'what did they need' → 'that/which they needed'로 고쳐야 합니다.

questions.question:
어법상 적절하지 않은 문장은?

ⓐSomi went to a zoo to see animals last Sunday. There ⓑshe didn't see a panda sleeping, and ⓒshe didn't watch a giraffe eating leaves from a tall tree, too. However, ⓓshe felt a sheep lick her hand, and ⓔshe also heard a parrot sing.
questions.explanation: 'too'는 긍정문에서 사용하고, 부정문에서는 'either'를 써야 합니다. ⓒ에서 'she didn't watch a giraffe eating leaves from a tall tree, too'의 'too'를 'either'로 고쳐야 합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Antonio, an Italian merchant, visited an island and traded with people there. One day he found out the islanders needed cats to get rid of rats. He presented two cats to the queen of the island, and she gave him valuable jewels in return. Luigi, another merchant in Italy, heard this and got jealous. He left for the island with wonderful gifts in his ship and met the queen. When Luigi offered his presents to the queen, she was thankful and gave Luigi the thing that was most valuable to her; a kitten. Though he was embarrassed, he realized what it meant to be that the queen gave him the kitten as a gift.

questions.explanation: 여왕은 자신에게 가장 소중한 것(새끼 고양이)을 루이지에게 선물했고, 루이지는 그 의미를 깨달았습니다. 이 글은 진심 어린 선물의 의미에 관한 내용입니다.

options: passed
ran
run
to run
gone
questions.question:
[지문]
Antonio was greatly surprised that there were rats in the palace. He asked, "Are there no cats on this island?" The queen looked puzzled. "What is a cat?" she asked.

The merchant said to himself, "What the islanders here need is not tools or books, but cats." He brought two cats from his ship and let them ⓐ____ free. "What amazing animals!" cried the queen when she saw all the rats ⓐ____ away. She gave Antonio a chest that was filled with jewels.

Back in Italy, Antonio told his friends about his good fortune. Luigi, the richest merchant in Genoa, heard the story and was jealous. "Cats are worthless," Luigi thought. "나는 여왕에게 정말로 귀중한 것을 가지고 갈 거야. I'm sure that the queen will give me more jewels."

윗글의 ⓐ에 공통으로 들어갈 가장 적절한 단어는?
questions.explanation: 'let them ⓐ free'에서 let은 사역동사이므로 목적격 보어로 동사원형 'run'이 와야 합니다. 'saw all the rats ⓐ away'에서도 지각동사 saw의 목적격 보어로 동사원형 'run'이 올 수 있습니다. (run away: 도망치다)

루이지는 안토니오의 행운을 축하해 주었다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Once, two friends were walking through the desert. At one point, they had an argument, and the older one slapped the younger one in the face.

(A) The older one asked, "After I hurt you, you wrote in the sand, and now you write on a stone. Why is that?"
(B) The older one watched him write in the sand, "Today my best friend slapped me in the face." The two kept on walking until they found an oasis.
(C) There they decided to wash themselves. The younger one fell and started drowning. Luckily, his friend saved him. Then the younger one wrote on a stone, "Today my best friend saved my life."
(D) The younger one replied, "When someone hurts us, we should write it down in the sand because winds of forgiveness can blow it away. However, when someone does what is good for us, we must record it on a stone. No wind can ever blow it away."

questions.explanation: 뺨을 맞은 후 → (B) 모래에 글을 씀, 오아시스 발견 → (C) 물에 빠졌다가 구조됨, 돌에 글을 씀 → (A) 왜 모래와 돌에 각각 썼냐고 질문 → (D) 이유를 설명. 따라서 순서는 (B)-(C)-(A)-(D)입니다.

To get a chance to meet the queen, he told the islanders a lie that he was a good friend of Antonio's. When the queen heard about Luigi, she invited him to her palace for dinner. Before sitting down at the table, Luigi gave the queen with all his gifts, and the queen thanked him again and again. "I'll repay you with a priceless gift," said the queen.

(A)

Luigi realized that, in the queen's mind, the kitten was worth far more than all the jewels in the world. He tried to look pleased with the gift. He know that was the right thing to do.

Luigi did not return home a richer man. But he was surely a wiser one.
